stage1.impression: It reads as a real-time-looking CG showroom, not a photograph. Two salmon-pink speakers glow flat and clipped in front of a dark tiled niche, the top sixth of the frame is an empty black void, and the green tub chairs are smooth, untextured shapes cut off at the bottom edge. A bright white screen at the left edge pulls the eye away from the speakers. As it stands a design magazine would not run it as a specific place: it reads as a generic dark lounge with a lit display.

blocking_9: Frame lum_median raised from 12.6 into 22-50 without lifting the black ceiling into a flat grey
Ember cabinets hold their red tint with clip_pct under 1% across both speakers (now 10.3%), with visible thickness and edge glow in the acrylic
The left screen is dimmed so it is no longer the brightest large surface (now median 171, against the speakers' 51-76)
Real material texture at 1:1: velvet pile and sheen on the chairs, end-grain block pattern with tonal variation in the niche, wool carpet texture
Sign of life in the zone (a glass, a sleeve on the table, a coat over a chair)
The ceiling and upper wall hold detail (beams, board-formed concrete) instead of a void
No green cone of light on the felt above the speakers that reads as stage lighting

defects.what: Ember cabinets blown to flat salmon pink, clip_pct 10.3% / 10.4%; the red reads as neon or signage, not tinted cast acrylic; the acrylic has no visible thickness or edge glow
the top modules (horn) read as a dark red smear; no form or edge detail
screen at the frame edge, median 171 and near white; the brightest large area, it competes with the hero and is cropped awkwardly
ceiling band is an empty black void (median 6), so the room reads as unlit CG space
a green-tinted cone of light on the felt above each speaker reads as a theatrical gobo and adds a second coloured light
the same green cone above the right speaker
the velvet chairs are smooth, untextured CG shapes with no pile or sheen; the foreground ones are cut off and fill the frame without detail
the end-grain block lining reads as a regular dark tile grid, uniform like a tiled texture
the carpet and platform are a flat grey plane with no texture or pooled light
the Orb lamp reads as a grey chrome ball, not smoked acrylic with a glowing frosted liner
a second Orb is cropped at the bottom edge, a stray bright fragment
no props or sign of life in the zone; the speakers are the same model twice (a pair, as specified, but nothing else breaks up the symmetry)

changes.problem: The Ember cabinets clip to flat salmon, losing their red tint and every sign of thick acrylic.

evidence.measured: clip_pct 10.31, p95 199, r/g/b median 134/59/63; right speaker clip_pct 10.39

change.setting: on each Ember speaker 4 x area, W/m2 at the target; altar 2 x spot
change.to: 2.0 W/m2; altar 45 W with the spots aimed to graze the cabinet sides so the edges glow

changes.expected: The cabinets read deep red with luminous edges and visible internal batts; no flat pink.

changes.problem: The frame is too dark overall and the zone's room light is missing, so everything outside the speakers falls into murk.

change.setting: render exposure, and the Domes' downlights
change.to: exposure +0.6 stop; add or raise the downlights over the zone so warm pools fall on the hex tables and chair backs

changes.expected: Frame median about 25-30, pools of light on the tables and seats, with dark between them.

changes.problem: The left screen is the brightest large area in the frame and pulls the eye off the altar.
changes.expected: The screen reads as a dim, glowing panel below the speakers' brightness.

changes.problem: Green-tinted cones on the felt above each speaker read as stage gobos and add a second coloured light at the altar.

evidence.measured: visible green-cyan cone over a felt median of 21.8; also at [460,140,520,220]

change.setting: the altar spots' aim, cone and haze
change.from: cone 28 deg aimed above the cabinets, haze 0.005
change.to: cone 36 deg with a soft edge, aimed down onto the cabinet tops and plinths; haze 0.002; check that the felt is neutral so it does not pick up the green bounce

changes.expected: No visible cone on the back felt; light lands on the speakers and the oak plinths.

changes.problem: The top sixth of the frame is a black void and the foreground chairs are cut off into dark blobs, so the composition reads as CG.

evidence.measured: lum_median 6.0, range 5.9: no detail at all

change.to: move back about 0.8 m and drop to a seated 1.15 m, 35 mm, shift down so the ceiling band shrinks; keep one chair back as a clean foreground frame instead of three cropped ones

changes.expected: The altar fills more of the frame, there is less void above, and the foreground reads as a deliberate seated point of view.

changes.problem: The velvet, carpet and end-grain lining read as smooth CG surfaces and a regular tile grid.

evidence.measured: chair lum_range 51 with no pile or sheen highlight visible at 2x; niche [200,100,450,340] is a uniform grid

change.from: smooth velvet, uniform end-grain tiles, flat carpet
change.to: velvet with a sheen layer and pile normal map (a bright rim where it turns from the light); end-grain blocks with per-block tone and ring variation of +-15%; wool carpet with a bump map

changes.expected: Each material reads at 1:1; the chair rims catch a lighter sheen.

changes.problem: The Orb reads as a chrome ball rather than smoked acrylic with a glowing liner, and lights almost nothing around it.

evidence.measured: lum_median 61, specular hotspot p95 203; the table top is barely lit

change.setting: each Orb W and glow; frosted acrylic roughness
change.to: 10 W, glow 1.8, a rougher frosted liner, lower clearcoat specular on the smoked shell

changes.expected: A warm, soft glow inside the smoked shell and a pool of light on the hex table top.

changes.problem: There is no sign of life, so it reads as a showroom.

change.to: a rocks glass and a record sleeve on the hex table, a scarf or coat over one chair arm

changes.expected: The zone reads as occupied a moment ago.

out_of_scope.request: Make the room's green less dominant so the speaker is the only saturated colour
out_of_scope.why: The card fixes the zone and its bottle-green colour; the 'one colour' test conflicts with the room's design by intent.

out_of_scope.request: Show the speakers' horn and top module more clearly through their form
out_of_scope.why: Their shape and parts are fixed; only the light on them may change (c1, c4).
